assets.name: 充电电钻
assets.prompt: Create ONE inventory illustration of an immediately recognizable cordless electric drill for a cyberpunk secondhand shop. A real believable hand-held power tool, with a stout brushed steel chuck and short drill bit pointing LEFT at the TOP, a substantial curved pistol grip descending down the RIGHT, a visible orange trigger, and a rectangular removable battery at the bottom of the grip. Overall portrait 2:3 proportions. The natural silhouette leaves an open space below the barrel at the lower LEFT. Do not turn it into a letter, puzzle piece, modular block, or stretched machine box. Keep correct tool anatomy and realistic proportions. Three-quarter view very close to a side view, whole object visible, strong simple recognizable silhouette; make chuck, drill bit, trigger and grip readable at small size. Distinctive scuffed safety-yellow body with dark rubber grip, brushed steel hardware, small cyan battery-charge indicator, traces of workshop dust. Painterly photorealistic game prop, restrained cyan ambient rim and warm neutral light. Genuine transparent background, no floor or cast shadow, no surrounding glow, no text, labels, logo, numbers, UI or border. Use the image bounds generously while preserving natural proportions.
assets.visualReview: Reviewed: recognizable functional parts and natural proportions, transparent cutout; inventory display uses proportional scaling.

assets.name: 三通阀
assets.prompt: Create ONE inventory illustration of a clearly recognizable three-way industrial pipe valve for a cyberpunk secondhand shop. The first read must be plumbing hardware: a thick oxidized brass horizontal pipe with large circular threaded sockets facing LEFT and RIGHT, a third threaded outlet pointing straight DOWN at center, and a distinctive RED spoked handwheel at the junction. A physically believable one-piece T-junction valve, not electronic blocks or a puzzle tile. Wide 3:2 overall proportions, almost front/top view with shallow perspective, both lower corners naturally empty. Keep round pipe bores, handwheel spokes and hexagonal unions large and legible at small inventory size. Worn bronze/brass, green oxidation, dull steel threaded collars, red painted wheel with chipped edges, no glowing screens. Photorealistic painterly game prop, warm overhead workshop lighting, a faint cool metal reflection. The entire valve in frame, generous close crop, natural proportions. Genuinely transparent background, no floor, cast shadow, fog or glow in the empty corners. No text, logo, UI, grid, border, extra parts or puzzle blocks.
assets.visualReview: Reviewed: recognizable functional parts and natural proportions, transparent cutout; inventory display uses proportional scaling.

assets.name: 折叠检修灯
assets.prompt: Create ONE inventory illustration of an unmistakable portable folding work light for a cyberpunk repair shop. A wide horizontal LED lamp head in the UPPER LEFT shows a large bright frosted-white rectangular diffuser with a visible row of small emitters; a short central articulated hinge support connects it to a broad rechargeable battery base in the LOWER RIGHT. The lamp head and base overlap around the middle, forming a natural staggered silhouette, with upper-right and lower-left corners empty. Wide 3:2 composition, shallow nearly orthographic FRONT view so the glowing light panel, hinge and battery base are instantly recognizable. Do not build the light out of colored puzzle squares or generic armored blocks. Correct mechanical proportions: clearly thin lamp-head housing, readable hinge joint and sturdy base with a carry loop and one physical round switch. Pale ivory and olive-green painted body, charcoal rubber edges, brushed metal hinge, light wear, a tiny amber charging lamp. Photorealistic painterly prop, warm neutral workshop illumination, restrained cool highlights; the diffuser glows within its panel only. Full object close framed, no stretching. Genuinely transparent background, no floor, cast shadow, atmospheric bloom, typography, numbers, logo, grid or UI.
